stages.breaks: Letting the brief grow every call.
stages.why: Features arrive in meetings and nothing leaves, so the date and the fee both break.
stages.does: A written scope with a feature list and a change process, so new asks are quoted instead of absorbed.

stages.breaks: Signing off a flow that nobody tried on a phone.
stages.why: Thumb reach and small screens expose problems that a slide deck hides.
stages.does: A clickable journey tested on real phones before code, so the first build is the right build.

stages.breaks: Promising a launch date before store review.
stages.why: A rejection or a missing asset costs days that your client counts on you for.
stages.does: We prepare listings, privacy details and test builds early, and tell you where review risk sits.

stages.breaks: Shipping without events to learn from.
stages.why: Without data you cannot show your client what the app earned or where users drop.
stages.does: Key events are set up during the build, with a plain note of what each one measures.

stages.why: When the relationship changes, vague ownership becomes a dispute you did not plan for.
stages.does: Ownership terms are written into the agreement, and code and documentation are handed over under your brand.
